model: Fit total seconds T=a+b*N+c*I(N=16) on original200 each question only; derive mean per source as b+a/N+c*I(N=16)/N.
uncertainty: HC3 covariance and Student-t reference; prediction assessed on new seeds without refitting.
no_causal_claim: Counts vary with scenes; no claim adding a source in every fixed scene helps.
